{'text': "Apple's September has been exciting, but its momentum will carry over into October, when several long-rumored new products are expected to be announced.", 'is_original': True}

{'text': '#1: Redesigned MacBook Pro / Ultra with touchscreen', 'is_original': True}

{'text': 'Mac has long resisted adopting a touchscreen, but that may finally change, with a new MacBook Pro (or MacBook Ultra) reportedly set to launch in October.', 'is_original': True}

{'text': "Apple's next-generation MacBook Pro is expected to feature an all-new industrial design — the first major overhaul in five years. Beyond touch support, it will also reportedly come with an OLED display, Dynamic Island, and possibly an optional C2 cellular modem.", 'is_original': True}

{'text': "A new look for the MacBook Pro is certainly long overdue. But even longer overdue than the redesign is Mac finally adopting a touchscreen — touchscreens have long been an industry standard, yet Apple has stubbornly held out. I can't wait to see how touch improves the Mac experience.", 'is_original': True}

{'text': '#2: A new Apple TV 4K', 'is_original': True}

{'text': 'The hardware refresh gap for the Apple TV has arguably been the longest in history. The current model is the third-generation Apple TV 4K, released in 2022.', 'is_original': True}

{'text': 'According to reports, we may finally see a new Apple TV 4K arrive in October, headlined by a powerful A19 or A19 Pro chip, alongside support for Siri AI.', 'is_original': True}

{'text': "Apple raised prices across most of its lineup this summer, and the Apple TV was no exception. That four-year-old Apple TV 4K now costs $199, well above its original $129 launch price. Hopefully the new model won't cost even more.", 'is_original': True}

{'text': '#3: A "HomePad"', 'is_original': True}

{'text': 'Rumors of a display-equipped HomePad are nearly as old as the HomePod itself. But in 2024, Mark Gurman published a detailed report that reignited the rumors, and the product is commonly referred to as the "HomePad."', 'is_original': True}

{'text': "Billy Coker's comment received the most likes", 'is_original': True}

{'text': 'Honestly, I don\'t want to see any more articles about the Apple TV unless it actually launches. It\'s always "coming soon," "coming soon," but it never actually arrives.', 'is_original': True}

{'text': "The HomePad is a smart display with a built-in speaker, and is reportedly set to be Apple's first major push back into the smart home market. It will run a new operating system that blends elements of iOS, tvOS, and watchOS, including a StandBy-like mode.", 'is_original': True}

{'text': 'Siri AI is expected to be at the heart of the device, which will also reportedly feature a camera, customizable widgets, and built-in Apple apps like Photos, Notes, Music, Calendar, and more.', 'is_original': True}

{'text': 'Of all the new Apple products arriving in October and beyond, which one are you most excited about? Be sure to drop a comment and let us know.', 'is_original': True}
